Your long years as a retainer came to an end not long ago. Through that decade, you turned over what the world's most absurd vehicle might be, all while quietly holding fast to the knight's creed of justice and humility. Then came the day when an old knight you'd known so well pressed a car key into your palm with his final breath. Standing before a champion forged of salmon, pineapple, and cheese, you couldn't help but feel this was perhaps the most ramshackle knighting ceremony anyone had ever witnessed.

The fluffy bear racer ahead of you lets out a ferocious roar from its engine, its fuzzy aura a weapon to throw opponents off their game. But you know what's really at stake: Nothing beats an engine running on fermented bean juice.
